reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be breaking down the world's largest e-commerce company, Alibaba.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be breaking down the world's largest e-commerce company, Alibaba. Alibaba was founded in 1997 by Jack Ma and almost 20 other co-founders as an online bulletin board that allowed small Chinese manufacturers to tell buyers around the world that they were open for business.. Today, Alibaba operates a sprawling ecosystem of businesses that includes e-commerce marketplaces, cloud computing, food delivery, logistics, and financial services.

key_points.text: Alibaba was founded in 1997 by Jack Ma and almost 20 other co-founders as an online bulletin board that allowed small Chinese manufacturers to tell buyers around the world that they were open for business..
In this breakdown, we discuss the staggering scale Alibaba's business, how Alibaba went from copycat to innovator.
For this episode, I'm joined by a special guest host, Claire Cormier Thielke.
